title: PagerDuty incident export
description: Schema for kpis/data/raw/pagerduty/<export>.json: a mirror of the PagerDuty REST API v2 GET /incidents response used by the incident_rate KPI. Incident fields keep PagerDuty's snake_case names because this is an upstream payload; incidents raised for Maxwell-managed changes carry an incident_key equal to the ledger incident.dedupKey ('maxwell:<controlId lower-cased>:<assetId>:<first 16 hex of the finding fingerprint>'), which is how an export line is joined to the soc ledger. Other incidents keep whatever key their source set, or null

incidents.title: UPI collect callback latency above 2s on kite-payments prod
incidents.description: p95 latency on /v1/upi/callback exceeded 2000ms for 10 minutes after rollout of the SBOM gating change for GV.SC.S5 on kite-payments-prod

exportedAt.description: When the export was fetched from PagerDuty

source.description: Query the export was produced with

apiVersion.description: PagerDuty REST API version; only v2 is supported

serviceIds.description: PagerDuty service ids the query was filtered to (service_ids[] parameter); omitted when all services were exported

since.description: Start of the queried window (since parameter)

until.description: End of the queried window (until parameter)

incidents.description: Incidents returned by the query, one object per incident, already paginated together

pagerdutyId.description: PagerDuty resource id: 5 to 20 upper-case alphanumerics, e.g. 'PT4KHLK'. Same pattern as soc record incident.externalRefs.pagerdutyId so ids round-trip into the ledger

maxwellIncidentKey.description: incident_key of an incident Maxwell raised: the ledger incident.dedupKey convention maxwell:<controlId lower-cased>:<assetId>:<first 16 hex of the finding fingerprint>, e.g. maxwell:gv.sc.s5:kite-payments-prod:3f7a1c2e9b4d4e6f. This is the single definition of the format; soc incident.dedupKey stores the same string verbatim so the two join by equality

reference.description: PagerDuty reference object (service_reference, team_reference, escalation_policy_reference, priority_reference) reduced to id and summary

summary.description: Human-readable name of the referenced resource as PagerDuty returns it

html_url.description: Link to the referenced resource in the PagerDuty web app

incident.description: One incident as returned by GET /incidents (PagerDuty REST API v2), field names verbatim. Lifecycle: resolved_at is required for status 'resolved' and forbidden otherwise; an incident_key starting with 'maxwell:' must be a ledger dedupKey

incident_number.description: Sequential incident number within the PagerDuty account

description.description: Longer incident description when set. PagerDuty returns an empty string for many incidents; the exporter writes null (or omits the field) in that case because empty strings are rejected

urgency.description: PagerDuty urgency; high urgency pages, low urgency notifies

updated_at.description: When the incident was last modified

resolved_at.description: When the incident was resolved; required for status 'resolved' and absent for 'triggered' and 'acknowledged'

incident_key.description: Deduplication key supplied by the triggering integration; null for incidents PagerDuty returns without one (manually created incidents). Incidents attributable to Maxwell carry the ledger incident.dedupKey 'maxwell:<controlId lower-cased>:<assetId>:<first 16 hex of the finding fingerprint>', e.g. 'maxwell:gv.sc.s5:kite-payments-prod:3f7a1c2e9b4d4e6f'; any other key is passed through and ignored by incident_rate

service.description: Service the incident was raised on

escalation_policy.description: Escalation policy that handled the incident

alert_counts.description: Counts of alerts grouped into this incident by state

html_url.description: Link to the incident in the PagerDuty web app

raw.description: Capped passthrough of any other top-level PagerDuty incident fields (type, self, is_mergeable, assignments, acknowledgements, body, ...) copied verbatim so nothing is lost when the upstream payload grows. Capped at 32 keys because the KPI never reads these; anything the KPI needs must be promoted to a named property
